content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Senior Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.information: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology, Trivandrum (Bio Medical Technology Wing)

content_sections.heading: About SCTIMST
content_sections.text: SCTIMST is an Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. This post is with its Bio Medical Technology Wing at Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The post serves the BIRAC-funded project P.8285, "New process technology (NPT) for gravity casting of total knee replacement implants".

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Senior Project Engineer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must be no older than 35 years on 01.10.2026. The notice does not require any experience. It lists the following as preferred: Computer-aided design and modelling of structures Design of jigs and fixtures Casting modelling / mould flow analysis Experience only counts if you gained it after earning the essential qualification. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, check the official notification.

rows.details: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering + M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
Masters in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in Production Engineering or Machine Design

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by walk-in interview. If many candidates turn up, SCTIMST may first hold a qualifying written test to screen them, and only those who pass will be interviewed. Marks from this written test, if one is held, do not count towards the final ranking.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is a project post. The appointment runs until 31.03.2027 at first and is likely to be extended until 02.11.2027. It is based at the Bio Medical Technology Wing in Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SCTIMST Senior Project Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the essential qualification and the age limit of 35 years on 01.10.2026. Fill in the Recruitment Report Form and prepare your bio-data. Go to Biomedical Technology Wing, Satelmond Palace, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram-695 012 on 10 November 2026. Report by 09.30 AM. If you arrive later, you will not be considered for selection. Take the written screening test if one is held, then the interview at 10.30 AM. Recruitment Report Form, filled in Bio-data Original certificates and self-attested copies proving age, qualifications, experience and other details A No Objection Certificate from your current employer, if you are already in service No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Project Engineer posts are there at SCTIMST?
faq.answer: There is one existing vacancy, and it is in the Unreserved (UR) category.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification do I need for this post?
faq.answer: You need both a B.Tech and an M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering. A Masters specializing in Production Engineering or Machine Design is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. Is experience required?
faq.answer: No. Experience is only desirable. The notice lists CAD modelling of structures, design of jigs and fixtures, and casting modelling or mould flow analysis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs.25,000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years, counted as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What time should I reach the venue?
faq.answer: Report by 09.30 AM on 10 November 2026 at Satelmond Palace, Poojappura. If you arrive after 09.30 AM, you will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: There may be, depending on how many candidates attend. It is a qualifying screening test, and its marks are not counted for the final ranking.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It runs until 31.03.2027 at first and is likely to be extended until 02.11.2027, under BIRAC-funded project P.8285.

faq.question: Q9. I am currently employed. What extra document do I need?
faq.answer: You must bring a No Objection Certificate from your present employer to the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel costs be reimbursed?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
